notes: Hand-labelled before the extractor existed (docs/phases/02-effects.md §7). Entries with partial=true compare only parse_error (and that 'parse_error' is an opaque reason). Entries with label_fix were corrected after the first run; the reason is recorded on the entry.

entries.cmd: if [ -f x ]; then rm x; fi
for f in *.log; do gzip "$f"; done
while read l; do rm "$l"; done < list.txt
case "$1" in start) run ;; stop) halt ;; esac
entries.label_fix: halt is catalogued as a power action (design doc §3.3, processes row); the original label wrongly called it an unknown program.
wget saves the server's response to the URL's basename (index.html for an empty path) unless -O is given; the original label omitted that write.
P4: OpenCode v2.3.0 webfetch input (url) recorded in the gold traces; it is now a network effect like Claude Code's WebFetch.
